# Jockkie

Jockkie is the personal brand of Jock Oosterveer, a Creative Technologist based in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. He builds AI systems that small business owners can run themselves — no dependency, no vendor lock-in, nothing outsourced.

## Who it's for

Small and medium business (MKB) founders who use AI but don't see results, and who want to own their own operation instead of renting someone else's.

## What Jockkie does

- Builds AI workflows and content systems for MKB founders, forward-deployed: in the client's business, learning the system, then handing it over.
- Works across story, sound and systems: AIPION (AI storytelling), Atmasvara (music and flow), Atmabodhi (self-knowledge), ToddlerRave (family events), Selene (personal dream and astro companion), ConstantiPostall (productized systems the client runs themselves).
- Transparent pricing, build in public, local-first and sovereign: your data stays yours.
